selection_type: purposive source-only development pilot; not random or complete benchmark
selection_principle: Original person replacement or clothing appearance task; source-only inspect visible local movements, retain a low-amplitude reading control. User authorized five IVEBench cases. Failures and UNKNOWN remain in fixed five.

geometry_recommendation.transform: isotropic downscale all original16:9 to1280x720, then blackpad16px left/right8px top/bottom
geometry_recommendation.score_geometry: crop fixed canvas padding back to1280x720 for both source and edited evaluation views; no person crop
geometry_recommendation.runtime_status: recommendation; root/builder must freeze executable preprocessing and decoded pixel mapping

metrics_scope: Use pinned IVEBench MF implementation on identical adapted 24fps physical prefixes; separately report pose timing. Five adapted tasks do not reproduce whole600 original leaderboard or12-metric overall score.
